outlook.statement: The global textile market is projected to reach USD 1.8–2.0 trillion by 2030, growing at 4–5% CAGR. For India, the textile and apparel market is expected to reach USD 300 billion by 2030. Exports are targeted to cross USD 100 billion by 2030, supported by FTAs, PLI, and PM MITRA Parks. For FY 2026-27, the industry outlook remains positive but will depend on execution of sustainability goals, digital transformation, and ability to remain cost-competitive while meeting global compliance standards.
